player_prompt.intro:
A waɗi Ɗaa {player_id} e Connect Four.
Alaaɓe ndeejo: {symbol}.
Leɓɓol e ɓangal woni {num_rows} e yimɓe, {num_cols} e kolomɓe.
Ɗaaɓe ɓe ɓe ɗon haɓɓe nder kolomɓe (0 haa {end_col}).
On woni ɓe ɗon ɓey ɓe (maɓɓe) ndeejo ononi huunde huunde, ɓe ɓe ɗon ɓey ɓe nder worgo, walla ɗemngal.
E jajirta ɓe, woni ina kolom nde ɗon haɓɓe nder ɓangal to make ɓe aɗa.
Feeɗɗorɗe: '[col 4]' walla '[col 1]'.

board.board_notvisible_state: Kambi kәndaye dә am bikkebe soye gәnyi sәdin.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ɗaa {player_id}, Aɗa kaaɓe fomati. Ina waɗa fomati: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ɗaa {player_id}, Aɗa kaaɓe. Kolom {col} woni ɓeyda.
invalid_move.already_full: Ɗaa {player_id}, Aɗa kaaɓe. Kolom {col} woni fulɗe.

outcome.win: Kambiwu {player_id} dәye nәm kәntagǝ diyau'a kəltәnzә lan kǝnasarzǝna!
